$comment: Layout of the assembled documentation site (#900, ADR-0005).
One slot per generator. scripts/builders/docs_site.sh mounts every wired
slot into one tree; scripts/checks/check_docs_site_slots.py fails when a
slot's state stops matching what is actually in the tree.
Generated output is never committed: everything below build/ is ignored.

slots.title: Markdown hub (MkDocs)
slots.reason: docs_hub.sh arrives with the hub slice (PR #931, base dev). Flip this slot to wired in the commit that merges it.

slots.title: Zig autodoc
slots.reason: docs_zig.sh arrives with the Zig autodoc slice (PR #943, base zig/dev). Flip this slot to wired in the commit that merges it.

slots.title: Rust crates (rustdoc)
slots.reason: no Cargo.toml anywhere in the tree yet. ADR-0005 reserves the slot; the checker fails the moment a crate lands, so rustdoc cannot be forgotten.
